Subject: E-sign platform feasibility & projected savings

Team / Acme procurement,

Quick note to kick off a short feasibility assessment for our upcoming CLM/e-sign renewal window. We currently have DocuSign and a handful of point solutions in use; with the contract renewal coming in Q3 we want to evaluate whether consolidating to a single vendor (or switching) reduces cost and operational overhead without increasing legal or security risk.

What I need in the next 7 business days:
- A one-page summary of the current footprint (licenses, avg monthly transactions, integrations) — Marissa, can you pull the license table?
- A baseline cost model showing current spend vs 3 consolidation scenarios (status quo, single-vendor consolidation, hybrid with open-source signing gateway) — Markus, can you own the model?
- Security/compliance checklist: SOC2, eIDAS, KMS key control, audit log retention — Laura, can you validate gaps?

I attached a short RFI template and an initial cost-model stub to fill. Acme procurement — thanks for sharing your usage estimates; Jessica (Signify) is copied if we want a quick vendor call next week.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_esign_rfi.pdf (PDF, 330KB)], [Attachment: cost_model_acme_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 110KB)]

Goal: present a recommendation and recommended procurement approach (renew, renegotiate, run RFP) at the 4/26 ops review.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-19T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: E-sign platform feasibility & projected savings

Team —

Initial cost modeling attached. High-level findings (very rough, please treat as draft):
- Status quo (renew DocuSign at current tiers): estimated 12-month cost = $418k (licenses + integration support).
- Consolidate to Signify (single vendor quote received from Jessica): 12-month cost = $372k, transition one-time work ~ $45k, potential SLA improvements.
- Hybrid (keep DocuSign + lightweight signing gateway for low-volume teams): 12-month cost = $255k (savings driven by replacing expensive DocuSign seats with gateway API for automated flows) BUT adds engineering maintenance and potential compliance gaps.

Assumptions included in the model: current envelope volumes, 10% annual growth, migration assistance at headcount rate $180/hr. I added a sensitivity tab for envelope counts and discount breakpoints.

Open risks:
- Data residency & key management: Signify supports customer-managed keys (HSM), but we need vendor attestation and proof of KMS integration.
- Migration complexity: mapped 12 critical Salesforce/CLM webhooks that would need adaptation.

Next steps proposed:
1) Laura to validate the compliance checklist against Acme's requirements.
2) Schedule a 30-min vendor call with Signify to clarify KMS and retention options.
3) Run a procurement mini-RFP with 2 vendors (DocuSign + Signify) to firm up commercial terms and migration credits.

Attachment: [Attachment: cost_model_acme_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 110KB)]

— Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Vendor Strategy | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-20T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: E-sign platform feasibility & projected savings

All —

Quick compliance readout after reviewing Markus' model and the RFI:
- SOC 2 Type II: both DocuSign and Signify provide reports; need latest report for 2026 — request from Signify on our vendor checklist.
- KMS / key custodianship: Signify's doc claims customer-managed keys for envelopes at rest, but we need a short runbook and a proof-of-concept on a non-prod tenant.
- Audit log retention: default 14 days for Signify; they have an add-on for 90 days. We should negotiate retention credits or include log export tooling as part of contract.
- eIDAS / EU cross-border signing: both vendors OK, but ask for signature validation evidence and chain-of-custody docs.

Recommendation: proceed with Markus' three-step plan. I will draft the compliance questionnaire to send to vendors and own review of vendor SOC reports.

Proposed meeting: 2027-04-22T10:00AM PT — 30m vendor Q&A (Signify + internal). Jonas, can you invite and include the procurement request list?

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
